label: PF Backlog 510
title: E4: review-model docs (LLM vs non-LLM, per-iteration granularity, PR gate) + wire into the artifact map
body:
## Problem / why
The review model (what is LLM, what is a gate, per-iteration, PR blocking) is undocumented.

## Acceptance criteria
A doc states: the LLM production-risk checklist, the non-LLM gates (pr_gate/security-audit/lint/secret-scan),
the per-iteration invocation, and the PR block; referenced from the artifact/owner map.

## Out of scope
Changing the pipeline stages.
